definitions: Any of a number of subatomic particles carrying a fractional electric charge, postulated as building blocks of the hadrons and existing in six flavours (up, down, charm, strange, top, and bottom) and three colours (red, green, and blue).
A type of curd cheese, similar to cream cheese, that is popular in Germany and other parts of Europe.
examples: The proton is composed of three quarks.
She spread the quark on her bread.
